info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Banking Accounts Alerts-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Accounts Alerts API enables the retrieval of alerts associated with banking accounts. Designed for financial institutions and developers, this API provides access to vital notifications and alerts that help users stay informed about their account status and activities. Typical use cases include monitoring transaction alerts, security notifications, and alerts related to account changes. By leveraging this API, institutions can enhance customer engagement and improve transparency in account management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch notifications and alerts linked to your account. It helps users stay informed about important updates and events.

requestBody.description: Request body to fetch alerts related to accounts. This may include parameters such as user ID, alert types, and date ranges to filter the results.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of alerts.
